method.descriptive: Per-policy historical counter schema; 10 transition metrics; exact agreement; missed/extra clears; total/new/averted losses; non-play choices; direct score order only on jointly scored play outcomes; per-game and ante counts.
method.estimator: Per-state ratio of sums; average continuation replicas within each game cluster; shared base counted once. Resample all 128 whole games, including games absent from a stratum.
limitations: One-step outcomes on factual teacher paths are not full-game counterfactual value.
Not clearing immediately may be a useful discard; non-play transitions are stepped but have no comparable hand score.
Only mode choices are replayed; not the full sampled policy.
Two continuations share one base; not independent pretraining replicas.
Same exposed panel as imitation diagnosis; not fresh confirmation.
No attribution of autonomous win differences from local costs alone.
method.uncertainty: All 18 unadjusted descriptive paired 95% percentile intervals and both replica point effects. Report nulls. No fresh scientific acceptance gate.
